description: Agent/Session usage aggregation — server time-bucketed endpoint + client activity-window snapshot, isolated from Issue completion metrics.

tasks.title: Server: time-bucketed usage aggregation endpoint
tasks.description: Add GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agent/usage to AgentRoutes.cs, delegating to a new AgentSessionQuerier.GetUsageTimeseriesAsync that aggregates persisted per-session AgentSession.Status.UsageSummary into fixed 7-day/daily UTC buckets. Add a CreatedAt time-range filter to AgentSessionQuery, the AgentUsageTimeseriesDto/UsageBucketDto response records, and an xUnit integration spec. DTOs are Agent/Session-only (no completion/issue fields).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agent/usage returns an object with RangeFrom, RangeTo, BucketGranularity="day", and a Buckets array.
Buckets are exactly 7 daily buckets with UTC day boundaries, ordered earliest to latest; a bucket with no sessions is present with zero totals (not omitted, not an error).

Bucket totals are the sum of persisted per-session UsageSummary additive fields (inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, costAmount) bucketed by session CreatedAt; completed sessions are included and sessions without persisted usage are skipped without failing.
costCurrency is echoed without conversion; range/granularity query parameters are ignored (v1 fixed).
An unknown or unauthorized project returns the same not-found/forbidden result as the other /agent/* routes (reuses ProjectResolutionEndpointFilter).
The response contains only usage fields (token/cost totals, bucket boundaries, currency) and no issue stage, status, completion, or readiness fields (context isolation).
A new xUnit spec under packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Api/ (e.g. AgentUsageTimeseriesApiSpecs.cs) exercises the route via ApiTestClient and asserts the behaviors above.
`dotnet build Mohist.sln` succeeds and `dotnet test Mohist.sln` passes with the new spec.
tasks.output: Server endpoint GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agent/usage returning daily usage buckets; green dotnet build + test.
tasks.notes: Use proposed v1 defaults from design.md: range = last 7 days, granularity = daily, timezone = UTC, currency echo = first non-null costCurrency (document single-currency assumption). Reuse AgentSessionJsonHelper.Usage(s) as the single usage definition shared with GetActivityAsync/ListCurrentAsync. Add the CreatedAt range filter to the existing AgentSessionQuery rather than a new store.

tasks.title: Client: activity-window usage snapshot selector + scope label
tasks.spec: specs/agent-usage-aggregation/spec.md#Client activity-window usage snapshot aggregates token/cost totals
tasks.description: Add a useActivityUsageSnapshot() selector (widgets/coder-session/model/usage-snapshot.ts) that derives token/cost totals from useAgentActivity().sessions[].usage via useMemo, plus a small scope-label UI surface that marks the totals as activity-window only. Sum only additive fields, treat null/missing as zero, exclude non-additive context-window fields.
acceptanceCriteria: useActivityUsageSnapshot() returns inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, costAmount, and costCurrency summed from useAgentActivity().sessions[].usage, computed in useMemo with no additional network request beyond the existing activity poll.
A session with no usage object or null/undefined additive fields contributes zero to each total and the selector does not throw.
Non-additive per-session fields (contextWindowUsed, contextWindowSize, contextUsagePercent, healthStatus) are not aggregated into any total.

The snapshot reflects only the sessions present in the current activity window; the UI renders a visible 'activity window only' scope qualifier next to the totals and never labels them project-total, weekly-total, or all-time.
A vitest unit test covers the selector math, null/missing handling, and non-additive exclusion; a component test covers scope-label visibility.
`npm run test:run -w packages/web` passes and the web typecheck/build is clean.
tasks.output: useActivityUsageSnapshot() selector + scope-label UI; green web vitest + typecheck.
tasks.notes: Follow the existing useActivityCards pattern (widgets/coder-session/model/activity-cards.ts). Proposed location: widgets/coder-session/model/usage-snapshot.ts. Independent of T-001 — reads only already-fetched activity data, so it is safe to ship before the server endpoint. Do not modify the server ActivitySummaryDto. Keep the snapshot purely in the Agent/Session usage domain (no completion-metric fields).
